content.overview: Vishay's automotive resistor solutions are designed to meet the stringent requirements of the automotive industry. All products are AEC-Q200 qualified and manufactured in IATF 16949 certified facilities.
content.technicalDetails: Our automotive resistors feature enhanced reliability with extended temperature ranges, improved moisture resistance, and superior thermal cycling performance. Available in various technologies including thick film, thin film, and metal film.
content.implementationGuide: When designing automotive applications, consider the operating temperature range, power dissipation, and required precision. Our FAE team can assist with resistor selection and layout recommendations.

content.overview: Vishay's industrial power resistors are designed for demanding applications requiring high power dissipation, pulse handling, and reliability in harsh environments.

content.overview: Vishay's precision resistor solutions offer the highest accuracy and stability for critical applications. Our portfolio includes thin film, metal foil, and wirewound technologies.
content.technicalDetails: Precision resistors feature ultra-low temperature coefficients, exceptional load life stability, and minimal noise. Available in various packages including through-hole and surface mount.
content.implementationGuide: For precision applications, consider the total error budget including tolerance, TCR, and load life stability. Our FAE team can help select the optimal resistor for your accuracy requirements.

solutions.title: Current Sense Resistor Solutions
solutions.description: Low-ohm current sense resistors for power management, battery monitoring, and motor control applications.

coreAdvantages.title: Low Resistance
coreAdvantages.description: Values down to 0.0005Ω for minimal power loss

coreAdvantages.title: High Power Density
coreAdvantages.description: Compact size with high power handling

content.overview: Vishay's current sense resistors provide accurate current measurement with minimal power loss. Available in metal strip and wirewound technologies with various package options.
content.technicalDetails: Current sense resistors feature low ohmic values, low TCR for temperature-stable measurements, and high power handling. Four-terminal Kelvin designs eliminate lead resistance errors.
content.implementationGuide: When selecting current sense resistors, consider the voltage drop, power dissipation, and required accuracy. PCB layout is critical - use Kelvin connections when available and minimize trace resistance.

customerCases.challenge: Required accurate current measurement for battery management system
customerCases.solution: Implemented WSL series with four-terminal Kelvin design
customerCases.result: Achieved ±1% current measurement accuracy, improved battery life estimation
